summary: import_role options: allow_duplicates, defaults_from, handlers_from, the required name, public variable exposure, rolespec_validate, tasks_from and vars_from.
questions: How do I run a different tasks file from a role?
How do I load an alternate defaults file in a role?
How do I skip role argument validation?
Can I run the same role twice with the same parameters?

answer_card.title: import_role parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `name` (required)
- `tasks_from`, `vars_from`, `defaults_from`, `handlers_from` (all default `main`)
- `allow_duplicates` (true)
- `public` (true): expose vars/defaults to play (parse time)
- `rolespec_validate` (true)
